title: Designing Optimal Binary Rating Systems
source_inventory_policy: Curated from the local PMLR main-paper and supplement text caches in source/garg19a.txt and source/garg19a-supp.txt. Items are source-facing theorem, lemma, definition, equation, and model-condition statements; support-only proof-route lemmas are retained so paper-level completeness does not depend only on compact dashboard rows.

model_nondecreasing_match_function.statement: Model setup: item quality is matched according to a nondecreasing match function g(theta), bounded above and bounded away from zero.
model_nondecreasing_match_function.source_location: Main paper Section 3.1, model and problem specification, lines 204-211 in local extracted text.

theorem31_two_stage_optimality.statement: Theorem 3.1: the optimal beta decomposes into an optimal discretization S* maximizing the limiting value and optimal levels t* maximizing the large-deviation rate among those discretizations.
theorem31_two_stage_optimality.source_location: Main paper Theorem 3.1, around lines 487-506 in local extracted text.

theorem31_adjacent_rate_expression.statement: Theorem 3.1 rate expression: r(t) is the minimum over adjacent intervals of inf_a {g_{i+1} KL(a||t_{i+1}) + g_i KL(a||t_i)}.
theorem31_adjacent_rate_expression.source_location: Main paper Theorem 3.1 display (3), around lines 500-506 in local extracted text.

lemma31_equalized_rates_optimize.statement: Lemma 3.1: the unique endpoint-normalized solution equalizing all adjacent rates maximizes r(t).
lemma31_equalized_rates_optimize.source_location: Main paper Lemma 3.1, around lines 534-548 in local extracted text; supplement Section C.4 proof.

theorem32_nested_bisection_runtime.statement: Theorem 3.2: NestedBisection finds an epsilon-optimal t in O(M log^2(M/epsilon)) operations.
theorem32_nested_bisection_runtime.source_location: Main paper Theorem 3.2, around lines 587-598 in local extracted text; supplement Algorithm 1 and Section C.6 proof.

lemmaB1_matching_rate_shift.statement: Lemma B.1: if matching rates shift upward above index k and downward below k, with equality at k, then the kth optimal beta level shifts upward.
lemmaB1_matching_rate_shift.source_location: Supplement Section B.3 Lemma B.1, around lines 854-865 in local extracted text.

theoremB1_uniform_subsequence_convergenc.statement: Theorem B.1: for uniform g, if the interval-quantile maps q_M^w converge uniformly, every dyadic subsequence beta_{C 2^N + 1}^w has a uniform limit.
theoremB1_uniform_subsequence_convergenc.source_location: Supplement Section B.4 Theorem B.1, around lines 896-905 and Section C.7 proof around lines 2385-2506 in local extracted text.

lemmaB2_known_type_learning.statement: Lemma B.2: with KnownTypeExperiment and Lipschitz psi(theta,y), empirical estimates converge uniformly to psi as the number of samples and representatives grow.
lemmaB2_known_type_learning.source_location: Supplement Section B.5 Lemma B.2, around lines 943-957 in local extracted text.

lemmaB3_unknown_type_learning.statement: Lemma B.3: with UnknownTypeExperiment and Lipschitz psi(theta,y), empirical estimates converge uniformly to psi as item count and samples grow.
lemmaB3_unknown_type_learning.source_location: Supplement Section B.5 Lemma B.3, around lines 960-980 in local extracted text.

lemmaC1_pairwise_error_rate.statement: Lemma C.1: the left-tail pairwise score error has large-deviation exponent inf_a {g(theta_1) I(a|theta_1) + g(theta_2) I(a|theta_2)}.
lemmaC1_pairwise_error_rate.source_location: Supplement Section C.1 Lemma C.1, around lines 1003-1038 in local extracted text.

lemmaC2_binary_complement_rate.statement: Lemma C.2: for Bernoulli scores with I(a|theta)=KL(a||beta(theta)), the complement pairwise ranking probability has the same infimum rate.
lemmaC2_binary_complement_rate.source_location: Supplement Section C.1 Lemma C.2, around lines 1050-1076 in local extracted text.

theoremC1_laplace_principle.statement: Theorem C.1: under compactness, finite measure, nonnegativity, essential infima, and uniform convergence of rate functions, the integral of exp(-n phi_n) has exponent -phi.
theoremC1_laplace_principle.source_location: Supplement Section C.2 Theorem C.1, around lines 1086-1138 in local extracted text.

lemmaC3_piecewise_constant_rate.statement: Lemma C.3: for piecewise constant beta with levels t_i, Wbar_k has exponent equal to the minimum adjacent Bernoulli rate.
lemmaC3_piecewise_constant_rate.source_location: Supplement Section C.3 Lemma C.3, around lines 1155-1270 in local extracted text.

lemmaC4_positive_rate_iff_piecewise_cons.statement: Lemma C.4: beta is piecewise constant if and only if Wbar_k has a positive exponential convergence rate.
lemmaC4_positive_rate_iff_piecewise_cons.source_location: Supplement Section C.3 Lemma C.4, around lines 1282-1315 in local extracted text.

lemmaC5_uniform_doubled_chain.statement: Lemma C.5: under uniform matching, the optimal beta_{2M-1} levels are obtained from beta_M by copying old levels and inserting the displayed square-root midpoint formulas.
lemmaC5_uniform_doubled_chain.source_location: Supplement Section C.4 Lemma C.5, around lines 1631-1945 in local extracted text.

corollaryC1_rate_tends_to_zero.statement: Corollary C.1: under uniform matching, for every epsilon there is M such that all larger finite optimal rates are below epsilon.
corollaryC1_rate_tends_to_zero.source_location: Supplement Section C.5 Corollary C.1, around lines 1958-2010 in local extracted text.

corollaryC2_adjacent_mesh_tends_to_zero.statement: Corollary C.2: under uniform matching, the maximum adjacent level gap tends to zero.
corollaryC2_adjacent_mesh_tends_to_zero.source_location: Supplement Section C.5 Corollary C.2, around lines 2010-2047 in local extracted text.

lemmaC6_monotone_penultimate_lower_bound.statement: Lemma C.6: if g is nondecreasing in theta, then the penultimate optimal level satisfies t_{M-2} >= 1 - 1/(M-1).
lemmaC6_monotone_penultimate_lower_bound.source_location: Supplement Section C.5 Lemma C.6, around lines 2047-2076 in local extracted text.

lemmaC7_uniform_rate_refinement_lower_bo.statement: Lemma C.7: under uniform matching, the refined optimal rate along the doubled chain is at least one fifth of the old rate.
lemmaC7_uniform_rate_refinement_lower_bo.source_location: Supplement Section C.5 Lemma C.7, around lines 2077-2150 in local extracted text.

lemmaC8_uniform_first_level_lower_bound.statement: Lemma C.8: under uniform matching, the first interior optimal level has a polynomial lower bound C M^{-3}.
lemmaC8_uniform_first_level_lower_bound.source_location: Supplement Section C.5 Lemma C.8, around lines 2150-2184 in local extracted text.

corollaryC3_monotone_first_level_lower_b.statement: Corollary C.3: under monotonically nondecreasing g, the first interior optimal level has a polynomial lower bound C M^{-3}, using Lemma B.1.
corollaryC3_monotone_first_level_lower_b.source_location: Supplement Section C.5 Corollary C.3, around lines 2184-2191 in local extracted text.

lemmaC9_nested_bisection_runtime.statement: Lemma C.9: NestedBisection runs in O(M log^2(1/delta)) operations for bisection grid width delta.
lemmaC9_nested_bisection_runtime.source_location: Supplement Section C.5 Lemma C.9, around lines 2191-2205 in local extracted text.

definitionC1_kendall_spearman_population.statement: Definition C.1: population Kendall tau and Spearman rho objectives are proportional to the displayed integrals of P_k.
definitionC1_kendall_spearman_population.source_location: Supplement Section C.8 Definition C.1, around lines 2515-2530 in local extracted text.

lemmaC10_spearman_weight_reduction.statement: Lemma C.10: Spearman rho can be written as an ordered-pair objective with weight w(theta_1,theta_2)=theta_1-theta_2.
lemmaC10_spearman_weight_reduction.source_location: Supplement Section C.8 Lemma C.10, around lines 2531-2614 in local extracted text.

lemmaC11_kendall_equispaced_intervals.statement: Lemma C.11: with constant weight, the Kendall interval objective is maximized by equispaced cutpoints.
lemmaC11_kendall_equispaced_intervals.source_location: Supplement Section C.8 Lemma C.11, around lines 2614-2629 in local extracted text.

lemmaC12_spearman_equispaced_intervals.statement: Lemma C.12: with weight theta_1-theta_2, the Spearman interval objective is maximized by equispaced cutpoints.
lemmaC12_spearman_equispaced_intervals.source_location: Supplement Section C.8 Lemma C.12, around lines 2629-2645 in local extracted text.

corollaryC4_kendall_spearman_uniform_sub.statement: Corollary C.4: for Kendall tau and Spearman rho, there exists beta such that beta_{2^N} converges uniformly.
corollaryC4_kendall_spearman_uniform_sub.source_location: Supplement Section C.7 Corollary C.4, around lines 2506-2512 in local extracted text.

source_definition_bernoulli_kl_formula.statement: Definition below Theorem 3.1: Bernoulli KL divergence KL(a||b) = a log(a/b) + (1-a) log((1-a)/(1-b)).
source_definition_bernoulli_kl_formula.source_location: Main paper Theorem 3.1 footnote/display, around lines 520-523 in local extracted text.
